# QR Code generator

`qrcodegen-v1.8.0.js` is the unmodified ES6 build from Project Nayuki's
[QR Code generator v1.8.0 release](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/tag/v1.8.0).
It is distributed under the MIT License, included at the top of the file.

Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/download/v1.8.0/qrcodegen-v1.8.0-es6.js

SHA-256: `6a1116192ed1dd67fa1bf31e77f5817103d71c23bbac24c382e698b7668bdd01`

PCForge uses it locally in the customer's browser to encode the authenticated
receipt URL. No receipt information is sent to a QR service. No build step or
package installation is needed.
